description: Shared blockchain primitives for Krao. Chains, accounts and assets use CAIP identifiers so EVM and non-EVM chains share one schema.

chainId.description: CAIP-2 chain ID, eg 'eip155:1' (Ethereum mainnet), 'eip155:8453' (Base) or 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (Solana mainnet).

accountId.description: CAIP-10 account ID: a chain ID plus an address, eg 'eip155:1:0xab16a96D359eC26a11e2C2b3d8f8B8942d5Bfcdb'.

assetId.description: CAIP-19 asset ID, eg 'eip155:1/slip44:60' (ETH) or 'eip155:8453/erc20:0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913' (USDC on Base).

nftRef.description: Reference to a single non-fungible token.

tokenId.description: Token ID as a decimal string (EVM) or the mint address (Solana).

walletProof.description: A signature by a wallet over a message that names the account's DID, proving the DID controls the wallet.

type.description: Signing scheme. 'siwe' is EIP-4361 (Sign-In With Ethereum), 'siws' is Sign-In With Solana.

message.description: The exact signed message. It must contain the account DID (as the SIWE/SIWS URI or a resource) so the proof cannot be replayed for another account.

signature.description: Signature encoded as 0x-prefixed hex (EVM) or base58 (Solana).

verificationStatus.description: Result of the AppView checking a claim on-chain.
